status: exploratory cone-side and perpendicular plane model
meaning: Finite lateral support measured along the unit axis from its local-z=0 reference point; conservative bounds enclose the band and top-plane guide. These are not inferred physical edges.
radius: reference_radius + taper * axial_coordinate; strictly positive at the reference and both support endpoints
residual: signed orthogonal distance to the lateral surface; projections outside support are rejected, with no cap/edge-distance substitution
constraint: plane normal equals cone axis exactly; plane offset is fitted independently, not fixed to a support endpoint
selection_policy: reuse the saved outer-band and top-face IDs unchanged; no residual trimming
weighting: one global normalization of whole-mesh incident-area weights across both selections
